systems.system: ICT policy for Local Authorities, with ICT standards
systems.country_label: ICT policy for the Local Authorities (harmonized ICT policy)
systems.owner: National Local Government Finance Committee with the Department of E-Government, Ministry of Information and Communications Technology
systems.tiers: all local authorities; validated 4 May 2026 and presented to Dowa District Council in May 2026; aligned with the 2023 National Digitalization Policy

note: A policy and standards for councils' ICT, with a 2022 situational analysis finding weak ICT support, no ICT projects and ICT expertise left out of procurement; the document does not say the policy covers the connection of council offices and states nothing on how they are connected.
